prompt: Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas containing ONLY SIX orthographic BOTTOM views, arranged in exactly SIX EQUAL COLUMNS x ONE ROW, left to right in the listed source order. Each column is one separate square floor-carpet tile viewed from directly BELOW, looking straight upward at its underside. No perspective, no isometric angle. Keep one complete object centered in each cell with generous transparent gutter; do not crop, overlap, add labels, gridlines, numbers, or extra objects. Pixel-art style must match the Pocket Dungeon reference: crisp clustered pixels, black/dark outlines, warm saturated red and gold palette, compact retro game texture. Use the supplied source-and-top contact only to identify the six variants and their footprints, not to copy top-facing details onto the underside. IDs in exact left-to-right order: clubs-guilds-club-carpet-floor (plain red-and-gold rug); clubs-guilds-worn-club-carpet-floor (worn/frayed rug); clubs-guilds-cracked-club-carpet-floor (diagonally cracked rug); clubs-guilds-wet-club-carpet-floor (puddles on upper face); clubs-guilds-club-carpet-edge-transition (rug next to hardwood strip); clubs-guilds-club-carpet-corner-transition (rug bordered by hardwood on two adjacent sides). Every view must be the full square XY footprint from below, matching the corresponding upper plan's dimensions. Show a physically plausible underside substrate: tightly woven dark crimson/brown backing cloth with stitched seams and subtle perimeter binding; retain warm gold rug binding where it physically wraps around the perimeter. For the two wood-transition cells, show the continuous underside of the square floor tile, with darker plank backing beneath the hardwood region and carpet backing beneath the rug region, following the same boundary placement as their supplied top plans. Keep each variant's condition subtly consistent through underside edge wear or seam damage, but do not put the decorative gold diamond carpet pattern, cracks/mounds, water puddles, upright wall faces, or top-view carpet surface on the underside. No metal tray, bolts, unrelated plate, additional shadows detached from the tile, or visible guide marks. Transparent outside each isolated square underside silhouette.
